# Maatify Slug

> An independent PHP slug lifecycle engine with clear boundaries between the slug domain, the Host, URLs, HTTP, and SEO.

Use this file only as a consumer navigation layer for `maatify/php-slug`. The supported package contract is defined by the canonical consumer documentation linked below. Repository internals, tests, fixtures, `AGENTS.md`, and internal Engineering Standards are not Supported Consumer Contract merely because they are visible in the repository. If the canonical consumer documentation does not support a claim, do not infer that contract from implementation internals.

- [Package Reference](SLUG_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md) — Canonical stable public/runtime/behavioral package contract and complete Public Runtime API inventory.
- [Usage Guide](docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md) — Consumer integration workflows, requirements, and package boundaries.
- [Examples](examples/) — Maintained examples using the documented Public API.
- [README](README.md) — Package overview, publication state, requirements, Quick Usage, and Public Runtime API overview.
